estimands.outcome: all-cause mortality, myocardial infarction, or ischaemia-driven revascularisation
estimands.missing_data_model: No imputation; use source-posted aggregate event counts and analysed denominators exactly as extracted.
estimands.aggregate_pool_rule: Pool only trials with the exact three-component composite available from aggregate records. CHAMPION-PHOENIX is not pooled in this aggregate-data estimand because its registered primary composite adds stent thrombosis and the three-component quantity is not recoverable from the object-held aggregate counts.

harmonisation_rule.harmonised_endpoint: No k=3 aggregate-data harmonisation is declared. Pool the exact three-component composite only where the source supplies that same three-component definition; otherwise report the trial narratively or require patient-level data.

eligibility.population: Adults with coronary atherosclerosis amenable to PCI with or without stent implantation and an acute coronary syndrome or myocardial infarction presentation as described in the source records.
eligibility.design: randomised interventional trial with concurrent cangrelor and clopidogrel arms in the PCI setting
eligibility.derivation_note: The page-level screening eligibility is absent. This clinical rule is derived from the registered eligibility text available for CHAMPION-PCI and CHAMPION-PLATFORM plus arm/intervention identity checks for all three trials. Outcomes are not used as eligibility criteria.

statistics.small_k_ci_rule: Hartung-Knapp t_{k-1} with variance inflation floor of 1; show the unadjusted interval alongside it when reproducing the stored object.

disclosure_clause.text: This is a retrospective protocol. When these methods were chosen, a page for this topic had already been served and the object already made the answer visible: the corrected three-component aggregate pool is k=2 with RR 0.9646 and 95% CI 0.8132 to 1.1442, while the withdrawn page value and the published patient-level analysis report OR 0.81. Registering this now is an honest rebuild contract, not pre-specification.

absolute_effect.ARR: Report only if a control risk source is available from an eligible source record; do not fabricate a baseline risk.
absolute_effect.NNT: Report only when ARR is computed from a declared control risk source; otherwise state not computed.
absolute_effect.control_risk_source: Eligible source record, preferably primary publication or supplement; registry-posted comparator event risk may be used when explicitly identified.

harms: major/minor non-CABG-related hemorrhage by clinically relevant GUSTO criteria
mandatory_outputs.rob2_source_note: The object records no recoverable RoB 2 assessment; manuscript, SAP, or regulatory evidence must be read before making RoB 2 judgements. Registry design alone is not a RoB 2 source.
